popCulture.title: Nostoi
popCulture.creator: Epic Cycle
popCulture.description: The lost Returns epic — Agamemnon murdered, Menelaus storm-driven, Nestor safe — the cycle that made homecoming a genre.

popCulture.title: Nostos
popCulture.description: Greek for the hero's return — the word that still names longing for home after war and wandering.
